title: fix(runtime,types)!: a NOT NULL refusal on a drifted column answers RestServer's body at the dispatcher and actions doors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X8KfVViUTX7B3bKxio5V96w)_

Fixes #26031

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@objectstack/types` adds the export `driverNotNullRefusalAnswer`)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What was wrong

#24768 (ruling A, PR #26026, merged as `48e84a90af`) has the engine translate a driver NOT NULL refusal on a field the object's field map holds into the record validator's own `ValidationError`, which every door already answers alike. A refusal on a column no field declares — drift, the field left the metadata and its NOT NULL column stayed in the table — is outside that ruling and still leaves the engine as the driver threw it, so the doors answered it three ways. Measured on `origin/main` `40bba68c` (which carries #26026), on a real better-sqlite3 store under `driver-sql` with the real engine and protocol:

| door | answer on `main` |
|:--|:--|
| `RestServer` `POST /data/:object` | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, the column's sentence, its `required` field entry and the drift `hint` (`mapDataError`'s NOT NULL arm) |
| dispatcher `POST /data/:object` | the raw `SqliteError` left `dispatch()`; the Hono exit declined it, so `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` |
| `POST /actions/:object/:action` | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the driver's text (`insert into [statement and bound values redacted] - NOT NULL constraint failed: drift_line_26031.legacy_code`) as `message`, and `declaredCode: 'SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_NOTNULL'` |

## The fix

`@objectstack/types` exports `driverNotNullRefusalAnswer(error, object?)`: `classifyDataError`'s answer when its NOT NULL arm is the arm that answered, `undefined` for every other answer. The arm's answer is now built in one place and held in a `WeakSet` the question reads by identity, so recognition is not a second reading of the driver's text and not a shape probe on a body: every arm ahead of the NOT NULL one (a declared status, a sandboxed body's throw, a unique violation, an unknown column, the record validator's `ValidationError`) still decides first, and this answers exactly where `mapDataError` would. `mapDataError`'s own answers are byte-unchanged.

Both runtime exits ask it and answer the arm's body in their own envelope — the sentence as `error.message`, `VALIDATION_FAILED` as `error.code`, and `fields`, `hint` and `object` in `error.details`:

- `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()`'s catch, for the `/data/:object` routes only (`routeObjectFromPath`, the same read its `PERMISSION_DENIED` arm makes, so the body's object is the route's as `RestServer`'s is). Every other throw leaves exactly as before.
- the actions door's catch, asked ahead of the fault predicate, so a driver class carrying no string `code` is still the refusal it is and never the sanitised 500.

⛔ No second copy of the recognition: neither door reads a driver code or a NOT NULL phrase. The declared-field answers #26026 pinned are unchanged, and the driver's text and code reach neither wire.

## `PATCH` cannot reach such a column

A `PATCH` naming the dropped field is refused before any driver runs, as an undeclared field (`400 INVALID_FIELD`), on both `/data` doors alike; a `beforeUpdate` hook writing it is refused the same way (probed); an update that leaves the column alone keeps the row's stored non-null value. So the `PATCH` case in the new pin is a control, asserted on both doors and unchanged.

## Clause-② — the measurement the order asked for

Declared `yes (widening)`, not `no (narrowing)`. By `clause2-line.mjs`'s own definitions the value answers 「本卡放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗」, and this diff does widen the published face: `@objectstack/types`' entry (`packages/types/src/index.ts:98` re-exports this module) gains the export `driverNotNullRefusalAnswer`. Nothing published is removed or narrowed — no export retires, no accept set shrinks, and no request that was served is now refused (every write in the measured class was already refused at all three doors; only the status, code and body move). The `(narrowing)` arm is therefore not owed: the two wire-answer changes make a refusal **more** informative (`500 INTERNAL_ERROR` → `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, and `VALIDATION_ERROR` with driver prose → `VALIDATION_FAILED` with the column's field entry). A consumer branching on `error.code` at those two doors is still affected, which is what the `**BREAKING**` banner in the changeset states, with the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; AGENTS.md's level rule puts a non-protocol change at `patch`, which is what ships.

`Metadata-protocol: none`, as expected: no spec key, authorable spelling, object definition, stored row or stored shape moves.

## Tests

Red first, on `origin/main` `40bba68c`, `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-not-null-drift-26031.test.ts`: 2 failed / 2 passed of 4 — the dispatcher `POST` (`expected { thrown: SqliteError } to deeply equal { returned: { status: 400, … } }`) and the actions door (`"code": "VALIDATION_ERROR"` against `"VALIDATION_FAILED"`) red, the `RestServer` reference and the `PATCH` control green. On the fix, 4 passed. Each case asserts the whole body with `toEqual`, and the two dispatcher-door bodies are compared against `RestServer`'s own answer read in the same run, so the `hint`'s words are never spelled here.

`packages/types/src/data-error-classification.not-null-label.test.ts` adds 8 cases for the new export (22 passed): the arm's answer equals `mapDataError`'s for all six dialect shapes and with no object, and `undefined` for the record validator's `ValidationError`, a throw declaring its own status, a sandboxed throw and node-postgres' fields-only shape — each of those carrying the NOT NULL text or code, so the pin measures the arm and not the words.

Neighbours green on the fix: `dispatcher-not-null-refusal-24768.test.ts`, `domains/actions-fault-vs-rejection.test.ts`, `dispatcher-unique-violation-wire-code.test.ts`, `rest/src/data-not-null-hint-20963.test.ts`, `rest/src/data-not-null-field-label-24715.test.ts`. Full package suites at `97265b90`: `@objectstack/types` 30 files / 800 tests, `@objectstack/runtime` 459 files / 8359 tests (19 skipped), `@objectstack/rest` 327 files / 6749 tests (344 skipped), all passed.

**Ablation**, one line, on the behaviour the new pins assert: `driverNotNullRefusalAnswer`'s `return NOT_NULL_ARM_ANSWERS.has(answer) ? answer : undefined;` replaced with a marker expression that always answers `undefined` (`ablation-replace --hold`, injected marker `grep -c` = 1, the anchor text `grep -c` = 0), `@objectstack/types` rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight @objectstack/types ABLATE_26031` exit 0 (marker live in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`). Red: the drift pins 2/4 failed (the two door cases), the types pins 7/22 failed. Restored: `ablation-replace --restore` reports `blob == HEAD (68e3d40ab2f6)`, `git diff HEAD` empty, whole-tree `git status --porcelain` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight exit 0, and both files green again (4/4 and 22/22).

## Gates

Local subset, the `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` list on this diff (66 commands, each exit code captured before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`): 65 exit 0.

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 on the first run — a shallow checkout cannot read its pinned positive control `621a487607`. After `git fetch origin 621a487607`, exit 0 (48 cases pass).
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3: `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, 33 packages have no `dist/`, which is a property of this container, not of the diff. A full `pnpm build` was run and the gate re-read; see the re-run line in the report.

`pnpm lint` is the repo-level scan CI owns; scoped runs on the touched packages are in the report. `test:repo` is CI's (`Test Core`). The families CI runs are cited from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.

## Acceptance notes

- The doors #26026's contract review (`6412927808`, boundary flag 2) named as not driven on a real store — import rows, the public form submit, the generic `/batch` and MCP — reach this class through `mapDataError` or `thrownRefusalEnvelope` and are unchanged by this diff; no pin is added for them here.
